metadata.description: Local single-plugin marketplace for tekton (plugin working name tekton). Add it with `/plugin marketplace add ./plugin` (this directory) then `/plugin install tekton@tekton`.

plugins.name: tekton
plugins.description: tekton — author native Revit .rvt files from a prompt, an IFC, or an existing .rvt (tekton-author), edit/delete inside them (tekton-edit), validate / render-inspect / audit / schedule (tekton-inspect), plus the Claude-Design IFC workflow (tekton-ifc); bundles the engine (lib/), the certified genesis base asset, job agents and the /revit-* commands. Working name: tekton.
